  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:2476689034",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "floating-point types cannot represent decimal monetary amounts accurately, causing imprecise or wrong values in RPC output",
      "quote": "this is wrong, you can't use `double` to denote monetary amounts. `double` is a floating point type, which can not represent decimal values accurately.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2479409437",
        "rc:2482777067"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2482777067",
      "settled_by_quote": "Done"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2476651745",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "encoding default values into the code logic prevents altering defaults without rewriting logic",
      "quote": "Please don't encode default values in how the code is written. This makes it impossible to change the default values without rewriting the code logic.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2479414797",
        "rc:2482397743"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2482397743",
      "settled_by_quote": "Thanks for the suggestion, yep it is cleaner. Now should be as easy as changing the default in the arg definition."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2496724101",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "drags an RPC-only dependency (UniValue) into a widely included policy header",
      "quote": "This drags an RPC‑only dependency (UniValue) into a widely included policy header.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2512314414"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2512314414",
      "settled_by_quote": "Moved the function into `core_write.cpp` and `core_io.h` similar to function `ValueFromAmount`."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:2496744390",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "introduces an RPC-to-RPC include and constructs an entire object with locking just to read two values",
      "quote": "This line constructs a full object (with locking) only to reuse two values. It also adds a new include `<rpc/mempool.h>` into `rpc/net.cpp`, creating an RPC‑RPC dependency.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:2512303937"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:2512303937",
      "settled_by_quote": "True! ... I think I just misunderstood and the intention was to maybe remove them in the future"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3517174948",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "changing the default unit format in the future would be a massive API break leaving downstream software readings orders of magnitude off",
      "quote": "It seems extremely dangerous to ever change the default... no matter how much notice is given, it's a massive api break that would cause software to suddenly be several orders of magnitude off.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3518313943",
        "c:3524763254"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3524763254",
      "settled_by_quote": "I don't think the default will ever be changed. I left the door open to it in some comments, but I would not push for it tbh."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4368198544",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "estimaterawfee produces mixed-unit responses by converting the top-level feerate but leaving pass/fail bucket ranges in sat/kvB",
      "quote": "`estimaterawfee` is converting only the top-level feerate when `satvB=true`, while `pass/fail.startrange` and `endrange` remained in the `sat/kvB` units.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
